 Norway vs Wales betting tips
 Norway host Wales at the Ullevaal Stadium in Oslo on Saturday 14 November, with kick-off at 5pm.
 Norway to win and Haaland to score 2+ goals (7/2) 
 Dan James to score anytime (11/2) 
 Both teams to score and over 3.5 goals (4/1) 
 Haaland Set To Make Up For Cardiff Misses
 Cardiff was a rare off night for Erling Haaland. He scored twice against Denmark and once against Portugal in the first two games of the group, then drew blanks against Wales and Portugal in Porto. Against Wales he headed one chance over from close range and another straight at Danny Ward. Ståle Solbakken admitted he looked tired after three full games in eight days. This time it is a two-game window, not four matches in 11 days, and Wales are patching up their back line, with Ben Cabango suspended and Joe Rodon back after two months out with a hamstring injury.
 Norway have lost three in a row and need points, but this is still the side that reached the World Cup quarter-finals this summer, knocking out Brazil and Ivory Coast on the way. Haaland is the Nations League’s all-time top scorer with 22 goals. Wales have never beaten Norway on Norwegian soil, and with the hosts desperate for a result, a brace from the man who has 65 for his country would not be a shock.
 Norway vs Wales tip 1 – Norway to win and Haaland to score 2+ goals (7/2)

 James Can Hurt Norway On The Break
 Dan James was at the heart of Wales’ best night of the campaign. He slid home the equaliser in Cardiff just before half-time, from a Sorba Thomas cross, then was dragged down by Torbjørn Heggem 15 seconds after the restart, which got the Norway defender sent off and led to Neco Williams’ winning free-kick. Wales have scored only twice in four group games, and James got one of them, so he is our Welsh pick.
 Norway’s back line had problems that night too. Julian Ryerson went off injured early on and his replacement, Marcus Holmgren Pedersen, spent the first half under pressure from Wales’ left side. Norway will have plenty of the ball at home, which should leave room behind them for James to run into. Wales put six of their 12 shots on target in Cardiff, to Norway’s four, and Harry Wilson is back after missing the opening four group games, so there is more quality around James this time. He scored against these opponents last month and has the pace to do it again.
 Norway vs Wales tip 2 – Dan James to score anytime (11/2)

 Both Sides Set To Go For It In Oslo
 Norway are not in the business of 1-0 games. Each of their last seven matches, stretching back to the World Cup, has had both sides scoring and at least three goals in total, and the 3-2 win over Denmark in September brought five. Even their goalkeeping has added to the chaos, with Ørjan Nyland’s error handing Portugal the winner in Oslo and Egil Selvik taking over for the return game in Porto.
 Both teams will want to chase this one. Wales and Norway are level on three points, only the top two go through to the quarter-finals and finishing bottom risks relegation. Craig Bellamy has said he sees this as a game to go all out for, with Portugal still to come in Cardiff on Tuesday, so Wales will not be sitting back. Norway need a win just as badly. Put two sides who both need to attack in one stadium and a score like 3-1 or 2-2 is more likely than a cagey 1-0. Over 3.5 goals with both teams to score is the bet we like.
 Norway vs Wales tip 3 – Both teams to score and over 3.5 goals (4/1)
